120                    SANSKRIT GRAMMAR.             [§ 197-198

e. g. रामश्च रामश्च रामौ, रामश्च रामश्च रामश्च रामाः । This is called
एकशेषद्वन्द्वः. In the case of the mas. and fem. genders the one
of the mas. gender is retained.* as हरी च हरयश्च हरीः; similarly
शाखौघी, खुरौ, अजौ, &c.

(a) This principle is further extended to some words dis-
similar in form, as in the following examples:—श्राता च स्वसा च
भ्रातरौ; पुत्रश्च दुहिता च पुत्रौ; माता च पिता च पितरौ (see also §193.),
श्वशुरश्च श्वश्रूश्च श्वशुरौ † (also श्वश्रूश्वशुरौ); स च सा च तौ, स च
देवदत्तश्च तौ, स च यश्च तौ or तौ×. In the case of words of the
mas. fem and neu. gender that of the neu. gender is retained; as
तत्र देवदत्तश्च ते; तत्र देवदत्तश्च यज्ञदत्ता च तानि ।

§ 198. The following rules should be observed in arranging
the various members of a Dwandwa Compound:—

(a) Δ A word ending in ऋ or उ should be placed first, and
when there are more than one of such words one of these should
be placed first, the rest being arranged according to the will of
the speaker or writer; हरिहरौ, हरिहरखराः; हरियहराः, &c.

(b) †† Words beginning with a vowel and ending in अ
ought to precede others; as अश्वरथयोः or इन्द्राग्न्योः. This rule
should have preference even over the above rule in case both
would be simultaneously applicable; इन्द्राग्नी.

(c) ॥ A word that has fewer syllables should be placed

* एकमाच् शिष्यते । Pāṇ. 1. 2. 67.

‡ श्वशुरः श्वश्र्वा । प्युदासिनि संज्ञापूर्वक् । Pāṇ. 1. 2. 71. 72.

× द्वौकैशेषोपि इष्यते इति भाष्यम् । Sid. Kau. on Pāṇ. 1. 2. 72.

Δ ऋक्रि च । Pāṇ. II. 2. 32. अनेकमसातावेकत्र नियमोऽनियमः शेषे । Vārt.

†† अजाद्यदन्तम् । Pāṇ. II. 2. 33.

नाह्वरणार्थमुपन्यस्तम् । अभ्यर्हितं च । Vārt.
